skill.name: miro-automation
skill.description: Automate Miro board workflows through the Rube MCP integration, including board lookup, item creation, connectors, and sharing.
skill.summary: Automates common Miro board operations through Rube MCP with current tool schema lookup.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around MCP tool names, parameters, and code fences. The only confirmed issue is a low severity dependency on the external Rube MCP endpoint; no prompt injection, shell execution, or malicious data exfiltration intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Document that users connect to the third-party Rube MCP endpoint and should review its trust, privacy, and OAuth permissions before use.

remediation.issue: Board sharing can grant access to collaborators
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation for recipient email addresses and access roles before invoking any Miro sharing workflow.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Miro connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `miro`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
2. `MIRO_GET_BOARD` - Get detailed info for a specific board [Optional]
- `query`: Search term to filter boards by name
- `board_id`: Specific board ID for detailed retrieval
2. `MIRO_CREATE_STICKY_NOTE_ITEM` - Add sticky notes to a board [Optional]
- `board_id`: Target board ID (required for all item creation)
- `data`: Content object with `content` field for sticky note text
- `style`: Styling object with `fillColor` for sticky note color
- `board_id` is required for ALL item operations; resolve via GET_BOARDS2 first
- Sticky note colors use hex codes (e.g., '#FF0000') in the `fillColor` field
- Frame items require `geometry` with both width and height
1. `MIRO_GET_BOARD_ITEMS` - List all items on a board [Required]
- Results are paginated; follow `cursor` until absent for complete item list
- `emails`: Array of email addresses to invite
- `startItem`: Object with `id` of the source item
- `endItem`: Object with `id` of the target item
- Use `position: {x: 0, y: 0}` for center of board
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- Email addresses must be valid; invalid emails cause the entire request to fail
1. Call MIRO_GET_BOARD_ITEMS with board_id and optional type filter
3. Extract item id for further operations

content.value_statement: Miro work often requires repeated board setup, item creation, and sharing steps. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows for reliable Miro automation.
actual_capabilities: Searches current Rube MCP tool schemas before selecting Miro actions.
Lists accessible Miro boards and retrieves details for a selected board.
Creates boards, sticky notes, frames, and bulk board items.
Reads board items and connectors with pagination guidance.
Shares boards with specified email addresses and roles.
Explains coordinate, pagination, and item ID requirements for Miro operations.
limitations: Requires a configured Rube MCP server and an active Miro OAuth connection.
Cannot operate on boards outside the connected Miro account permissions.
Depends on current Rube MCP tool schemas, which may change over time.
Does not include custom scripts or local validation utilities.

use_cases.title: Prepare Workshop Boards
use_cases.description: Create frames and sticky notes for planning sessions without manually placing every item.

use_cases.title: Audit Existing Boards
use_cases.description: List board items, connectors, and members to understand the current collaboration state.

use_cases.title: Standardize Product Diagrams
use_cases.description: Build repeatable Miro layouts with consistent frames, notes, and connections.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Board
prompt_templates.prompt: Find my Miro board named "Quarterly Planning". Search the current Rube MCP Miro tools first, then list close matches.

prompt_templates.title: Create Sticky Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Add five sticky notes to my selected Miro board for goals, risks, owners, timeline, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Workshop Layout
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a workshop frame with grouped sticky notes for discovery, decision points, actions, and follow-up items.

prompt_templates.title: Map Connected Items
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the board items, identify related notes, and create connector guidance for a clear process map.

output_examples.input: Find boards related to roadmap planning.
output: Searched the available Miro board tools through Rube MCP.
Found matching boards by name and recent activity.
Returned board names, owners when available, and next action options.

output_examples.input: Create a sprint retrospective section on this board.
output: Created a frame for the retrospective section.
Added sticky notes for wins, blockers, improvements, and action items.
Placed items using the board coordinate system to reduce overlap.

output_examples.input: Share the board with two reviewers as commenters.
output: Resolved the target board before sharing.
Prepared commenter access for the requested email addresses.
Recommended verifying board members after the share action completes.

best_practices: Search Rube MCP tool schemas before every workflow because available parameters may change.
Resolve board names to board IDs before item, connector, or sharing actions.
Confirm email addresses and roles before sharing any Miro board.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode board IDs across accounts or workspaces.
Do not create many individual items when a bulk operation is available.
Do not share boards externally without explicit user confirmation.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Miro account?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires a connected Miro account through Rube MCP and the required board permissions.

faq.question: Does it run local scripts?
faq.answer: No. The skill is guidance for MCP tool calls and does not include executable scripts.

faq.question: Can it create a new Miro board?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes using the Miro board creation tool when that tool is available in Rube MCP.

faq.question: Can it work with existing board content?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide board item lookup, connector review, and item organization workflows.

faq.question: Can it invite collaborators?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes board sharing guidance, so users should confirm recipients and roles first.

faq.question: Why does it search tools first?
faq.answer: Rube MCP tool schemas can change, so current schemas reduce parameter errors and failed actions.
